messages:
Harper Nguyen: Heads-up: NorthLight is evaluating moving their chat stack from NorthStar -> Redwood for a week-long pilot. CTO flagged three blockers: API parity, surge pricing during live demo, and a security questionnaire. Can we triage?
Diego Marquez: I'll own API parity. Do they stream and use candidate arrays for rerank?
Harper Nguyen: Yes, streaming chat with candidate lists returned for client-side reranking.
Elena Gomez: Security team received a 40+ question vendor pack. Key asks: SOC2 scope & date, customer-managed KMS support, SSO (SAML/Okta), subprocessor list, and data residency.
sec-bot: [auto] Uploaded questionnaire: https://redwood-internal/sec/northlight-poc-2026
Diego Marquez: Parity plan: spin up a compatibility proxy on staging that accepts NorthStar payloads, maps `messages`->`input`, translates model names, preserves message/candidate ids, and emits `partial_delta`/`done` events to match their stream semantics. Will also synthesize `usage.prompt_tokens` and `usage.completion_tokens` in the final response.
Owen Park: For rerank flow they call /v1/rerank referencing prior candidate ids. Proxy must generate deterministic IDs (hash-based) so rerank resolves. I'll implement id-preservation mapping.
Elena Gomez: KMS ask: For Private we support customer CMKs (AWS/GCP). For hosted SaaS, offer envelope encryption with customer KMS in VPC pilot. I'll draft this for the questionnaire and attach SOC2 cert and pen test summary.
Harper Nguyen: Procurement Q: "If traffic spikes 2x during the demo, what happens to billing?"
Diego Marquez: For POC offer trial credits + temporary burst allowance. Recommend soft alerts at 1.25x and a hard throttle >3x; finance to confirm overage pricing.
Elena Gomez: Also need to confirm SLA (they want 99.95) and maintenance window policy. Legal will need to review SLA addendum.
Harper Nguyen: Timeline: exec demo in 8 business days. Can we deliver a parity run (10 canonical prompts + rerank cases) and security answers by EOD +4?
Diego Marquez: I'll run the side-by-side parity tests and push proxy config to staging. ETA EOD +3.
Owen Park: I'll implement id-mapping for candidates and rerank API resolution. ETA EOD +3.
Elena Gomez: Security pack draft and attachments to procurement by EOD +2.
Harper Nguyen: Action items: Diego parity + proxy (EOD+3), Owen id-mapping (EOD+3), Elena sec answers + attachments (EOD+2), Harper to confirm demo window and schedule 15m tech sync (today).
Harper Nguyen: Kickoff call set for tomorrow 10am PT. Please join if you have action items. Post short status updates here only. :rocket:
